notes: The flagged three-morpheme unit was not retained. gate is the noun's own English word, so rule 30's one-rendering condition fails; rule 22 marks the repeated noun unrepresented, rule 14 marks the waw unrepresented for want of a written connective, and rule 15 puts the supplied determiner every in the noun's unit without heading it.
The competing reading keeps every gate whole as the one rendering of the distributive repetition; it was rejected because a morpheme of that phrase owns part of the English.
